release_encoder_source: joint_schema_model.py encode_record(max_length=16384) and systemone(max_length=16384) in the snapshot: the release truncates the state silently so that prefix + state + schema fit in 16384 tokens, and raises ValueError when the schema alone needs more
served_context_note: integer for a context check: the engine's max_len is CLEF_MAX_STATE 16384 (the state piece: 36-token system prefix, media placeholder tokens, the rendered state) plus CLEF_MAX_TAIL 4096 (the schema and the 18-token suffix). A request above either limit is refused with 422 instead of the release's silent truncation; CLEF_TRUNCATE_STATES=1 opts into truncation of the state to its first tokens and marks the response. The longest state validated end to end, on device and over HTTP, is 16384 tokens (below)

shipped_mode.why: doc/optimized/README.md, 'Why eager is the default': the traced engine compiles vision-tower programs after capture for an image grid outside its warm list, which the trace allocation tracker reports as unsafe; eager has no live traces and accepts any grid
shipped_mode.traced_opt_in: CLEF_TRACED=1 with CLEF_VISION_WARM_GRID listing every admitted (t, h, w) grid; a request with another grid, or with more than one image or video grid (the per-image ttnn.concat of tt/vision.py is a program the one-grid warm-up never compiles), is refused with 422 at the server and in the engine before any tower op (/v1/models traced_media.rule); multi-image and multi-video requests are served by the eager default
shipped_mode.gdn_conv_kernel: fir in both modes (the eager masked buckets always run the FIR kernel; a traced engine sets QWEN_GDN_CONV=fir)
